messages:
leah-sales: FYI -- AstraMed wants to run nova-13b-adapt on Dedicated in EU with BYOK/HSM and 8k context. They asked for a compatibility check, rough POC timeline, and a quote for 4-bit inference. Model artifact: https://artifacts.astramed.ai/nova/13b-adapt.tar.gz. CC @tom-eng @isabel-ml
tom-eng: Got it. Quick checklist: tokenizer type? rotary? n_head? custom attention? Also need license permission to quantize/modify.
leah-sales: Manifest in customer portal. Key: tokenizer=bytepair, rotary=false, n_head=40, ctx=8192. License looks permissive but they'll confirm in email.
isabel-ml: Bytepair tokenizers are usually fine. KV-cache layout should be standard given n_head=40, but need an automated inspect to be sure. Quant path: recommend NF4; we should run a 500-prompt sanity eval first.
dante-sre: EU Dedicated and BYOK supported but HSM onboarding requires vendor certs and network egress rules. We'll need signed DPA + SOC2 report before placement.
mira-secu: Security checklist: require completed questionnaire, DPA, and explicit consent for model transforms. Also note we redact inputs by default; audit logs possible per contract.
orch-deploy-bot: Inspect job queued (id=120455). Estimated runtime: 90m.
tom-eng: Inspect done: tokenizer OK, but tokenizer vocab order differs causing off-by-one token shifts in some prompts. KV-cache layout PASSED. Ops: no custom fused kernels. Logs: https://redwood.internal/jobs/120455/logs
isabel-ml: Token offset issue fix options: (a) customer provides tokenizer files with canonical vocab order, (b) we add a small adapter and remap offsets. Adapter usually ~1 day to validate.
leah-sales: AstraMed wants POC in 10 business days if possible. Can we hit that?
dante-sre: Realistic: adapter + 500-prompt eval + quant run = ~4 business days, plus legal/DPA/HSM which is variable (5-10 bd). So optimistic 2 weeks, conservative 3-4 weeks.
tom-eng: Pricing: rough FP16 token cost on Dedicated ~ $0.02/1k tokens; NF4 could drop to ~$0.009-$0.011/1k tokens. Final number after batch tuning and quant eval.
leah-sales: I'll request tokenizer files and signed consent for transforms, and upload the sec questionnaire. Will update when we have docs. :thumbsup:
